subject: Curb queue & valet handoff protocol for SF exec workshop
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-28T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Curb queue & valet handoff protocol for SF exec workshop

Team —

Attached is my first-pass plan for the curb queue and valet handoff for the June 10 Acme exec workshop (see site_map_v3.pdf). Goal is to have a deterministic, low-friction arrival flow for 48 attendees across three vehicle classes: dedicated car services (BlueLine + SharedVehicles), pre-arranged rentals (short-term pool), and rideshare. Key constraints: narrow curb on Howard St (two lanes), no commercial staging allowed on Market St between 07:00–10:00, and Gate D is the only freight/loading access we can use for the valet handoff.

High-level asks: 
- Marissa: you own vendor coordination and placard printing. Need final vendor/vehicle counts by EOD Monday.
- Vivek: confirm passenger groupings (A/B/C arrival windows) and where to stage the rental fleet.
- Ben: confirm rental allocation and on-site inventory list; we may need 6 additional SUVs for VIP runs.

Proposed curb plan (short):
1) Three arrival windows: 08:30–09:00 (Group A, VIPs), 09:00–09:30 (Group B), 09:30–10:00 (Group C, remaining).
2) Dedicated car services stage at Lot E (2 blocks north); they get a 10-minute loading window and a direct handoff at Gate D.
3) Rideshare dropzone at Lane 2 eastbound — guests either walk 90–120s or get a 30s trolley for elevated guest support.
4) Valet team receives vehicles at Gate D, perform quick manifest match (placard color + name) and shuttle keys to staging on-site.

I've attached a simple CSV for staging placards (valet-staging.csv) — idea is color-coded placards that match the door hosts' manifests. Please review and flag any missing operational constraints.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Manager, Events & Customer Programs
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Curb queue & valet handoff protocol for SF exec workshop

Grace —

This looks good as a starting point. A few operational clarifications from vendor conversations this morning: 

- BlueLine can staff an additional two SUVs for the 08:30 window but need a guaranteed 10-minute pull-in per vehicle to avoid blocking the main lane.
- SharedVehicles confirmed a 6-car pool but requests an on-site liaison to rotate keys; they will stage on the north side of Lot E (as proposed).
- SF Valet asked for a physical staging table at Gate D plus a small weatherproof canopy; they also need a copy of the building loading permit to show parking enforcement.

Actionables I can own: 
- Finalize placard numbering and print run (will use the valet-staging.csv).
- Provide vendor routing diagram to all drivers and add a staff radio channel for the day.
- Confirm pick-up coordination for post-event departures (we should block Lane 1 from 16:30–17:30).

Attaching a short checklist I'll use on the day (not the full ops doc): site_map_v3.pdf, valet-staging.csv.

Marissa

- Valet team will run a short manifest check: placard color, guest last name, and vehicle plate. Please ensure the csv fields in valet-staging.csv include plate numbers once available.
